definitions.response_time: time from sending a request to receiving its result
definitions.lost_result: no usable result within the request timeout, or dropped because too many requests were already waiting
definitions.late_result: lost, or completed slower than the analysis deadline; share of all requests with a recorded outcome
definitions.longest_result_gap: longest interval between two consecutive results
definitions.unnecessary_reversal: a server switch back to the server just left, within the reversal window
definitions.time_on_suboptimal_server: time spent on a server other than the best one by a measurement-only reference scorer, identical for every controller mode
